correctness.rationale: For any mixed allowed cyclic word, maximal alternating zero/one runs give nonnegative integers (a,y,x,b) with t=a+y>=1, 0<=x<=t and x=0 => b=0. Its exact 3-gram profile is (b,x,a,y,x,t-x,y,0), and conversely an explicit run construction realizes every such quadruple. The coordinates recover the quadruple. With weight w=a+2y and length \(n=2w-y+x+b\), elementary counting gives \(C_{n,w}\); independent polynomial-series arithmetic establishes its rational generating function, while Riemann sums and exact pole analysis prove the asymptotic and period. Literal exhaustive verification to n=16, constructive verification to n=70 and bivariate coefficients to n=70 all passed. No finite test is used as the proof of an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The invariant is exactly the noiseless message capacity of a fixed-composition constrained cyclic three-gram multiset channel used as a model of bounded-homopolymer string readout. Fixed-weight coefficients matter because codebooks often fix symbol composition. The answer resolves all n and weights, not a selected tiny instance, gives constructive code representatives, a sharp \(n=3w\) saturation boundary, a composition-density phase law and an exact order-12 quasipolynomial. These facts are not supplied by source-word counts or generic growth rates.
